purpose: Complete the standard/base TL3 candidate table across all visible research disciplines and the standard PDS subfamilies while preserving subsystem identity, current construction rules, and the distinction between candidate registration and runtime/calibration/promotion.
scope: Base/standard TL3 technology only. Later pinnacle legacy-family items, additional Auxiliaries, specialist weapon variants, missile subcomponents, alternate armor packages, batteries/capacitors, magazines, hangars, and other optional support remain separate future additions.

baseTableBoundary.description: The base table names the representative standard TL3 capability for each existing technology stream. It does not exhaust the catalog. Later research may unlock pinnacle lower-TL families, specialist variants, or Aux components without changing this base row.
baseTableBoundary.example: A later Optimum Fission Reactor may remain a fission-family item while benefiting from later Power research; it is not the base TL3 reactor and is not defined by this checkpoint.

hull.notes: Capacity rises by the minimum integer step 35->36. Hull durability, personnel, cargo and shuttle capacity do not also increase. Structural refit requires drydock/rare equivalent.

armor.notes: TL3 adds real Protection while holding TL2 Integrity.

powerReactor.notes: Miniaturization only; raw output held at 6 TP.

stlDrive.notes: Normal Move follows installed STL TL. The bounded overload remains +1 Move rather than scaling multiplicatively with base Move; no footprint reduction is bundled.

ftlDrive.notes: Strategic Move follows installed FTL TL. No footprint reduction, faster preparation, or exploration-bypass benefit is bundled.

tacticalComputer.notes: Compensation offsets only the ship own-fire Evasive penalty to a minimum residual penalty of zero; excess never becomes a bonus.

shield.technologyRole: Mature shield integration with optional powered hardening

kineticMainWeapon.notes: Hold packet, range, accuracy and penetration; maturation removes the ordinary discretionary Tactical-Power firing burden. Finite ammunition remains the family cost. No Approximate-fire permission is bundled.

energyMainWeapon.notes: The former TL1 overload-level DAM4 output becomes a rated safe High mode. No automatic DAM5/4-TP overload is created.

missileMainWeapon.notes: Maturation is propulsion/autonomy rather than a larger warhead. Onboard navigation sensing becomes standard for local tracking/reacquisition; seeker remains an optional later subcomponent/variant.

kineticPds.notes: Deliberate base TL3 hold; no placeholder improvement. Existing local/self-contained PDS rules remain.

energyPds.notes: Principal maturation is readiness efficiency from 2 TP to 1 TP; accuracy and RC are held.

ammPds.notes: Accuracy and magazine are held; the player may spend another readiness TP for a second total reaction, preserving the normal two-attempt-per-flight cap and automatic seeded allocation.

deferredOutsideBaseTable: Pinnacle lower-TL families such as a future Optimum Fission Reactor
Additional Auxiliary/support components beyond the already registered Shield Hardener
Special Kinetic ammunition or Approximate-fire weapon variants
Energy overload beyond the rated TL3 High mode
Missile seeker and detailed onboard-navigation-sensor subprofiles
Magazine expansions, batteries/capacitors, Shield Boosters, hangars, fabrication/mining, backup systems and other specialist Auxiliaries
guardrails: Preserve subsystem identity; do not improve every statistic or family symmetrically.
Candidate registration is not implementation, calibration, or promotion.
Construction legality is separate from simultaneous Tactical Power sufficiency.
Second Main Weapons and Reactors remain legal explicit full-Space design choices when the hull can fit them; do not add arbitrary anti-stacking rules.
The TL3 base hull and reactor deliberately do not make a two-Main/two-Reactor cruiser fit.
A one-reactor dual-Main ship may fire both weapons when family/mode power costs permit, but broad support operation must remain constrained by the same Tactical Power pool.
Main weapons and primary drives retain their current large footprints at TL3; compact fusion and +1 Hull Space are the only base-table Space-density gains in this pass.
Broader Auxiliary/pinnacle technology can be added later without rewriting the base TL3 row.
